svg.title: Nominal and ordinal fitted response probabilities

cc:Work.dc:title: Nominal and ordinal fitted response probabilities
cc:Work.dc:description: Lines at age five with 90% posterior intervals for probabilities; crosses are unadjusted observed category proportions by load band, not age-matched validation. Rows compare original ordinal and changed nominal generators.
